title: Linear resource growth
contract: Under bounded per-item cost of at most two units, a scan processes n items with work at most 2n and terminates.
scope: n 0..5, per-item cost 0..3; admission cost<=2; finite count model.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

variants.description: Rescan all n items for each item.
Use a single fold over item costs.
